company_source.quote: dit LONGBOAT KEY, Fla. , Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RUM Group Inc. (NASDAQ: RUM) (“RUM Group” or the “Company”), an AI infrastructure and video company on a mission to unlock the power of human imagination, today announced that it will release financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 .
